GRID auto layout: grid tracks (fixed / hug / flex), spans, anchors, gaps, row and column reorder; .fig GRID frames import; an auto-layout panel in the window re-solves frames on edit
Figma arrow and line-end caps import as stroke arrowheads and draw in frame export
Per-frame and per-layer export settings with one run writing PNG/JPG at a scale, width or height, plus SVG and PDF framed on the board (SVG frame export was missing)
New blank design documents with artboards; artboard add, move, resize, rename, options
A model can drive instance edits and the prototype player (dispatch a trigger, capture a frame) through the process without a window
Create components, combine them into variant sets, add properties, place, detach and sync instances in a native document, by typed command

affinity.what: Macros: record a command sequence and replay it as one undo step; batch jobs apply an action to many documents with naming, overwrite and error policies
HDR merge of bracketed photos (alignment, ghost removal) into a 32-bit image, global tone mapping to 16/8-bit, floating-point DNG of the merge
Arrowheads on strokes (catalogue of 26, scale, inside/outside), set in the Stroke panel, kept through SVG import/export
Text frames auto-size (height, width, both, proportional) and every first-baseline kind
Typed text on a path, in a shape and as point text, editable from the window, with Create Outlines
Designer panels in the window: appearance, stroke, swatches, graphic styles, align & distribute, transform, path operations, masks, envelope distort, brushes, SVG/PDF export, .ai import
EPS vector import works again through a vendored PostScript interpreter with free fonts (opt-in feature)
Swatch groups, document/application/system palettes, colour books and ICC named-colour profiles
Spare channels: save a selection to a channel and load it back, rename/reorder/duplicate/delete channels, PSD and TIFF keep them
Image mode conversions grayscale to bitmap (dithers, halftone) and RGB to indexed colour
Soft proofing with proof conditions, gamut warning and colour-vision proofs; raster gradient tool, paint bucket and Edit > Fill; Info panel with histogram and samplers; develop spot healing
Publisher engine depth: CJK line-breaking rules, liquid layout rules, TOC and index persistence, PDF export presets and preferences, booklet imposition, ink manager, deeper paragraph composer
